corrected interpretation (see ftml #792): this rendered value is accurate for the combined capture page, but it was downstream of flat-pairing corruption on that page: live Wikidot pairs an unclosed [[iftags]] opener flatly with the next [[/iftags]] later in the document (across paragraphs, no nesting), so everything from this paragraph onward was corrupted. In isolation, an unclosed opener with no later closer renders literally and FTML matches (parity); the flat pairing itself is tracked in #792, not a seam-typography difference
